source: Original fictional demo content created for ExamSprint

notes.title: Welcome to Cipher Harbor
paragraphs: Cipher Harbor is an imaginary floating city. Its training vault uses colored badges and simple rules so new harbor keepers can practice careful decision-making.
A teal badge opens the Map Room. An amber badge opens the Engine Deck. Visitors may enter either room only when escorted by a keeper with the matching badge.

notes.title: Spark seals
paragraphs: Every supply parcel receives a fictional spark seal. Add the parcel's three rune values and keep only the last digit. A parcel marked 4, 7 and 5 therefore receives seal 6 because 4 + 7 + 5 = 16.
The receiver calculates the value again. A different result means the parcel changed or the label was copied incorrectly, so it must be inspected.
bullets: Seal = last digit of the rune sum
Matching seal: continue the delivery check

notes.title: The night-watch drill
paragraphs: When an alarm appears, keepers follow four fictional steps in order: identify the affected pier, isolate its gate, restore the latest clean map, and record what happened.
Skipping directly to restoration can spread confusion because the affected gate may still be connected to the rest of the harbor.

questions.text: Which badge opens the fictional Map Room?
questions.explanation: The Cipher Harbor rule assigns the teal badge to the Map Room.
questions.explanationNo: I de oppdiktede havnereglene brukes det turkise adgangskortet til kartrommet.

questions.text: Which badge opens the fictional Engine Deck?
questions.explanation: The Engine Deck uses the amber badge.

questions.text: What must a visitor have before entering either training room?
questions.explanation: Visitors need a keeper whose badge matches the room.
questions.explanationNo: En besøkende må følges av en keeper med riktig adgangskort.

questions.text: What is the first step in the night-watch drill?
questions.explanation: The drill begins by identifying the affected pier.
questions.explanationNo: Øvelsen begynner med å identifisere hvilken brygge som er berørt.

questions.text: What should happen when a recalculated spark seal is different?
questions.explanation: A different value means the parcel must be inspected.
questions.explanationNo: En ulik verdi betyr at pakken må stoppes og undersøkes.

questions.text: A parcel has rune values 3, 8 and 4. What spark seal should it receive?
questions.explanation: 3 + 8 + 4 = 15, and the seal keeps the last digit: 5.
questions.explanationNo: 3 + 8 + 4 = 15. Seglet bruker det siste sifferet, altså 5.

questions.text: A keeper has an amber badge and escorts a visitor. Where may they enter?
questions.explanation: The amber badge matches the Engine Deck, so the escort rule is satisfied there.
questions.explanationNo: Det ravfargede kortet passer til maskindekket, så følgeregelen er oppfylt der.

questions.text: Which sequence follows the night-watch drill correctly?
questions.explanation: The fictional procedure is identify, isolate, restore, then record.
questions.explanationNo: Den oppdiktede prosedyren er identifiser, isoler, gjenopprett og dokumenter.

questions.text: A parcel label says seal 2, but rune values 9, 6 and 8 are visible. What should the keeper do?
options: Send it to the Map Room
questions.explanation: 9 + 6 + 8 = 23, so the expected seal is 3, not 2.
questions.explanationNo: 9 + 6 + 8 = 23, så riktig segl er 3 og ikke 2. Pakken må undersøkes.

questions.text: Why does isolation come before restoration in the drill?
options: To keep the affected gate separated
questions.explanation: Isolation separates the affected gate before a clean map is restored.
questions.explanationNo: Isolering skiller den berørte porten fra resten før et rent kart gjenopprettes.

questions.text: A teal keeper escorts two visitors to the Engine Deck. What is the correct decision?
options: Allow them because an escort is present
Deny entry because the badge does not match
questions.explanation: An escort alone is not enough; the escort must carry the badge assigned to that room.
questions.explanationNo: Det er ikke nok å ha følge. Keeperen må ha kortet som passer til rommet.

questions.text: Two parcels show rune values 1, 4, 8 and 6, 2, 5. Which statement is correct?
questions.explanation: Both sums are 13, so both fictional seals use the last digit 3.
questions.explanationNo: Begge summene er 13, så begge seglene får siste siffer 3.

questions.text: A gate is restored before it is isolated, and the alarm immediately spreads to another pier. Which missed step best explains the result?
options: The gate was not separated first
questions.explanation: The drill isolates the gate before restoration to stop the problem from spreading.
questions.explanationNo: Porten skulle vært isolert før gjenoppretting for å hindre at problemet spredte seg.

questions.text: A visitor enters the Map Room with an amber escort and carries a parcel whose seal matches. Which rule is still broken?
questions.explanation: The matching parcel seal does not replace the need for a teal Map Room escort.
questions.explanationNo: Et riktig pakkesegl erstatter ikke kravet om turkis følge til kartrommet.

questions.text: Rune values are 7, 7 and 9. The label shows seal 3, and an amber keeper escorts the parcel to the Engine Deck. What should happen?
options: Stop: amber cannot enter the Engine Deck
Continue only after changing the seal to 9
questions.explanation: 7 + 7 + 9 = 23, so seal 3 is correct, and amber matches the Engine Deck.
questions.explanationNo: 7 + 7 + 9 = 23, så segl 3 er riktig. Ravfarget kort passer også til maskindekket.
